summary: My Size, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing a September 15, 2026 securities purchase agreement for a private placement of up to 1,308,901 pre-funded warrants and associated Series C and Series D warrants at $1.91 per unit. The pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.001 with no expiration; the Series Warrants are immediately exercisable at $1.66, with the Series C warrants lasting five years and the Series D warrants 18 months from the effective date of a resale registration statement. The company must file a resale registration statement within 15 days and secure effectiveness within 45 to 75 days, subject to liquidated damages. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
